_doc: Minimum SSIM of the leading 400 pt strip (compare.mjs result.strip.ssim) per platform and screen. Plan 5.4 and section 10 (Q9): iOS 0.90 map-heavy / 0.85 text-heavy; Android 0.85 map / 0.80 text (owner decision). 'interim' lowers a floor below the target while a known gap is open; the gate uses interim when present. Ratchet up, never down, except by an explicit interim entry with a reason. A screen that is not a strip (the full-width Log) sets "metric": "frame" on iOS to be gated on the whole frame instead of its leading 400 pt: its lower half is empty paper, which lifts the strip score so much that a blank screen passes (0.867 against the 0.85 floor). Android keeps the strip for it: its screen is 800 dp wide against the 1032 pt reference, so the right-aligned content of a whole-frame crop cannot line up (a blank Log scores 0.7955 on the Android strip, just under the 0.80 floor).
